description_en: Erases text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and watermarks from e-commerce images. This feature automatically identifies these elements and allows you to specify objects to be removed, enabling efficient and accurate processing of large batches of images to simplify image editing
description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作
name: ImageRemovalProAsync

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format. The resolution must be between 256×256 and 3000×3000, and the file size must be less than or equal to 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
原图 URL，图像需是 JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP 格式。
· 分辨率 256×256 至 3000×3000，文件大小 ≤ 10MB
